response.sql: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(c.client_id) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), shares AS (SELECT region, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM region_counts) AS share FROM region_counts), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS m FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.region, s.cnt, s.share FROM shares s, mean_share ms WHERE s.share > ms.m) SELECT SUM(a.cnt) AS total_clients, AVG(a.share) AS avg_share, AVG(a.share - ms.m) AS avg_excess_over_mean_share FROM above a, mean_share ms;
